title: external-facing-website site spec
description: One JSON file describes one landing page. Keys starting with '_' are comments and ignored. See references/site-spec.md.

date.description: Start date of the page; kept when it is updated so the link never changes. Must be a real date.

description.description: Meta description. PUBLIC even on a PIN-gated page (folder README).

built.description: Date shown in the footer (default: today).

contact.description: Who partners write to. Default: contact in site.json.

tagline.description: One public sentence about the program. No numbers or results: the lock screen is not encrypted. Default: page.description.
